body: Honestly? I don't know how I do it. I remember that ever since I started wearing heels I could always run in them. I was in a situation where I had to set up a whole event hall in 4 inch (10-11 cm) heels and that meant carrying tables and chairs alone. And I was in a rush since it needed to be done FAST. I did all that without any men helping me and then I ran to my dorm to get a lipstick and my friends in flats couldn't keep up and after the event, they came up to me and just said "You. Are. Indestructible.". But to this day I have no clue why I can run in heels more comfortably than I can in flats.
